<parameter=text>
The revolution won’t be televised, it will be streamed online. This catchphrase, a modern twist on Gil Scott-Heron’s famous line, encapsulates the dramatic shift in media consumption habits over the last decade. Traditional television networks are struggling to keep up with the plethora of streaming services available. The power dynamics in the entertainment industry are undergoing a major transformation as audience preferences continue to change.
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
